ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity distribution; macro-level ratio of approximately 1:12 high-intensity (white/light-gray) to low-intensity (dark-gray/black) pixels.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Low-intensity pixels occupy the central and medial regions; high-intensity mottling and focal light spots are concentrated at the distal lobe tips; a distinct high-contrast white vertical band is located on the extreme right distal tip.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Sharp V-shaped depression; calculated vertex angle of approximately 40-45 degrees; notch depth is clearly defined against the lighter horizon.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous jagged serration along the entire trailing edge; high-frequency sawtooth peaks with amplitudes ranging from 1 to 5 pixels; highest variation density located on the outer distal thirds of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Trailing edge exhibits a concave curve extending from the median notch to the distal tips; lobes are oriented at a steep upward-lateral angle.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Clusters of roughly circular high-contrast light pixels (diameter 3-6 pixels) visible on the distal portion of the right lobe and scattered sparsely on the left medial lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent high-intensity white scar tissue occupying the terminus of the right lobe; irregular jagged excision/notching on the extreme edge of the left lobe tip.
